title: Configurable warning lights including Orangelink battery level [enhancement]
body:
Warning lights on the overview screen are really useful, but can contain indicators that aren't used (e.g. Sensor battery level shows '-' for BYOD users) and doesn't show others that are used (e.g. Orangelink battery for Eros/Medtronic users).

It would be useful:
- if the user could enable/disable warning indicators and for Orangelink to be added as a configurable item
- OR if AAPS automatically displayed relevant warning lights based on the system's configuration
